title: Beyond a Naive Absolute Infinite
content: Class ordinals and class cardinals are first defined as an extension of ordinals and cardinals, which are called set ordinals and set cardinals. In order to create an unambiguous definition of a maximally large class, this definition needs to quantify over all class theories. Accordingly, the Axiom of Maximal Strength (AMS) asserts that there exists a class cardinal that does not provably exist in any infinitary MK-extending fragment that has an injective theorem-preserving interpretation into a consistent infinitary extension of ZFC that is definable by a formula without parameters in the infinitary first-order language L∞,∞. This property is called non-infinitary-first-order-interpretability. The meta-theory TM that interprets AMS is presupposed to be sound, infinitarily-first-order-complete, an infinitary extension of MK, and to prove that absolutely every object is a class. It is then proven that TM is consistent with AMS, that TM is maximally strong, and that the class Ord of all the ordinals TM proves to exist, is a consistent version of Cantor's absolute infinite Ω.
